text:
Priya: Heads-up — after the routing change last night a customer hit a flurry of SSE reconnects. Console shows 1.2k resume attempts in 2m for tenant=acme-inc ; logs have a repeated resume_id value.
Samir: which routing change? the region->cost-tier sticky routing rollout? @priya can you paste an example log line?
Priya: yep that one. log snippet:
```
[2025-11-12T03:41:12Z] INFO proxy: resume attempt tenant=acme-inc resume_id=R-42a7 session=opaque-7f3 route=eu-west-1 -> backend=gpu-pool-4
[2025-11-12T03:41:13Z] INFO proxy: resume attempt tenant=acme-inc resume_id=R-42a7 session=opaque-7f3 route=eu-west-1 -> backend=gpu-pool-3
[2025-11-12T03:41:13Z] WARN proxy: lease conflicted tenant=acme-inc resume_id=R-42a7
```
Jordan: resume_id repeated across different backends + lease conflict. That implies resume_id namespace isn't namespaced by tenant or rollout id. Oops.
Emily: Console traces only show stream-level counts, no resume_id histogram. We can't quickly correlate replays -> billing deltas. console-bot: added tag request:resume_id to traces failing (auto-note)
Samir: hypothesis: during rollout the router started stripping tenant prefix from resume tokens in the encode/decode path. If tokens collide, proxy will try multiple backends and reissue resume, causing duplicate replay and token double-charge.
Priya: confirmed — the resume token format changed in the new router image: previously `<tenant>::<opaque>` now just `<opaque>` for cheaper routing keys.
Jordan: can we hotfix by treating resume ids as namespaced server-side (i.e., prefix with tenant when persisting leases) so old tokens don't collide? That avoids a rollback.
Emily: needs console support: add a per-tenant "resume_collision_rate" metric + sample traces that store original token string (masked) and route history. Otherwise ops can't triage.
Samir: for immediate mitigation: 1) pause the rollout 2) patch proxy to check if lease.owner != tenant -> reject resume 3) emit metric resume.rejected-by-tenant-mismatch
Priya: paused rollout at 03:45 (deploy-bot confirms): deploy-bot: rollout pause ack for image=router:v3.7.2 at 2025-11-12T03:45:02Z
Jordan: longer-term, make resume id generation include region+tenant+rollout-id hash. Also add idempotency key on token reconciliation so replayed stream frames are deduped.
Emily: UX ask: console route view should show "active resumes" timeline and surface the first backend that accepted the resume. Current Drilldown doesn't show acceptor, only client-side reconnects.
Priya: created a tiny repro script to show collision locally, pushed to inc/eng: gist: https://gists.internal/repro-resume-collision
Samir: I'll open a PR for server-side tenant-prefix guard and the new metric. Jordan can you own console change (surface acceptor in traces)?
Jordan: yes will prototype a lightweight column: acceptor_backend and a resume_outcome tag (accepted/denied/collided). Console-bot: opened ticket #ENG-4321 for console trace fields
Priya: thanks. action items: Samir PR for guard + metric, Jordan console probe, Emily add dashboard panel for resume collisions, rollback if we see >1% customer session duplication in next 30m.
Samir: will also add a short lived alert: resume_collision_rate > 0.5% for any tenant -> page oncall.
Priya: FYI billing team: we should run a small diff to check duplicate token charges for acme-inc and refund if necessary. Emily can you coordinate with billing?
Emily: on it. I'll export the resume ID timeline and billing token usage and sync with billing ops.
Priya: thanks team. keeping thread open until we confirm root cause patch in prod. /cc @all
